summary: Tested BUG-1 (coach training hidden on away match days), UI-2 (date in OGGI/DOMANI/DOPODOMANI), UI-3 (compact admin matches page). Backend: 3/3 tests passed - training is hidden on BOTH home and away match days for coach commitments endpoint. Frontend code review confirms date format in section headers across coach/parent/athlete/minor dashboards. Admin matches page UI verified visually post-rebuild: title 'Calendario Gare' bigger on one line, compact 'Info importazione' icon replaced the big blue card, Template button preserved. IMPORTANT: had to rebuild the Expo web bundle (npx expo export -p web) because /app/frontend/dist contained a stale May 4 build - so any UI changes were not visible to end users until rebuild.
action_items: IMPORTANT: The Expo web is served from a static dist/ directory (supervisor command: `npx serve -s dist -l 3000`). Frontend source edits do NOT take effect on the live URL until `cd /app/frontend && npx expo export -p web --output-dir dist` is run. The testing agent had to rebuild manually. Main agent should run the export command after any frontend change so users see the updated UI, or change the supervisor command to a hot-reloading dev server.

Optional: in /app/backend/server.py around lines 11911-11960 the variable `home_match_days` is now misleading because it actually contains BOTH home and away matches that hide training. Suggest renaming to `match_days` (and `home_match_rifinitura` -> `match_rifinitura` is still home-only so keep that name). Not a bug, just a naming refactor.
